QuestInfo.name: Athena's Letter
QuestInfo.1: According to #p1033226#, someone at the #b#m105000000##k knows how to awaken the Elves. This is your chance to free your people!
QuestInfo.2: You met #p1033227# in the #m105000000#. Is this the man who can save the Elves?

0.0: #b(You read the simple letter you've received.)
0.1:
My dear Mercedes, I've heard a rumor about somebody who can awaken the Elves. There is a person waiting near #b#m105000000##k who knows of these matters. I'm busy with another investigation, so I don't know when I'll get to see him. I thought you should know about this.

Your loyal servant, #p1012100#

yes.0: #bWhy didn't #p1012100# tell me this in person? Odd. And she writes very differently from how she talks. Ah, it is no matter. If this person in #m105000000# can lift the curse from my people, perhaps I should pay him a visit myself.

1.0: Hey there! You're Mercedes, aren't you? #p1012100# wrote you might come by!
